[LGRA.2.9.6.7] `{{` / `}}` escape literal braces. In every string position, the
compiler must refuse any other unescaped `{` or `}` that forms no valid site
([LGRA.2.9.6.1]) with `DS_VALIDATE_INTERP_BAD_PATH`, and must not keep it as
literal text. A valid site in a string where interpolation is not eligible is
[LGRA.2.9.6.8]'s. A `json()` argument is outside this clause: its braces are
literal text ([LTSL.4.1]).
